spells.description: Steam-Jet Gauntlet (once per short rest): a creature within 5 ft makes a STR save DC 15 or is pushed 10 ft. Costs a Steam-pressure charge.

effects.name: Knockback
effects.description: Force enough to hurl the target away from its attacker.

spells.materialComponent: the Steam-Jet Gauntlet

spells.name: Thermal Grenade
spells.description: Throw 12 m: 10 ft radius, DEX save DC 15 - 2d6 fire on a failure, half on a success. Uses one Thermal Grenade.

requiredConsumables.name: Thermal Grenade
requiredConsumables.description: A ceramic shell that releases a Thermal capsule's heat all at once. 10 ft radius, DEX save DC 15: 2d6 fire on a failure, half on a success. Consumed on use.

spells.materialComponent: a Thermal Grenade (thrown)

spells.name: Pressure Ram
spells.description: Fire the piston at a door, gate, object or creature within 5 ft: 3d6 force and the target is knocked back; advantage on checks to force doors. Costs a Steam-pressure charge.

effects.name: Knockback
effects.description: Force enough to hurl the target away from its attacker.

spells.materialComponent: the forearm Pressure Ram piston

spells.name: Bolt Repeater: Concussion Bolt
spells.description: Bonus action: the Bolt Repeater fires a Concussion Bolt. Ranged attack with INT, 30 m: bolt damage 2d6 + 1d4 force, STR save DC 15 or pushed 5 ft. Uses one Concussion Bolt.

requiredConsumables.name: Concussion Bolt
requiredConsumables.description: Bolt ammunition with a reinforced tip and a Force capsule core. On hit: normal bolt damage + 1d4 force, and the target makes a STR save DC 15 or is pushed 5 ft. One bolt per shot.

effects.name: Knockback
effects.description: Force enough to hurl the target away from its attacker.

spells.materialComponent: the Bolt Repeater loaded with a Concussion Bolt

spells.name: Thermal Smoke Grenade
spells.description: Throw 12 m: a 10 ft radius cloud of hot smoke heavily obscures the area; a creature entering or starting its turn inside takes 1d4 fire. Needs exactly one Thermal capsule (no other type works).

effects.name: Blinded
effects.description: Cannot see; automatically fails sight-based checks and attacks at disadvantage.

effects.name: Burning
effects.description: Flames cling to the target and keep searing it each round.

spells.materialComponent: a Thermal Smoke Grenade primed with a Thermal capsule (thrown)
